summary: Established a canonical continuity spine so current scientific context is reconstructed from explicit machine state/ledgers rather than arbitrary report order or conversational memory.
local_effect: Added machine-readable context/authority state, architecture and experiment ledgers, generated live views, and a canonical experiment registry.
global_effect: Cross-chat/cross-agent state reconstruction becomes an explicit repository function.
claim_changes: A report existing in the repo is no longer sufficient to treat its contents as remembered/current; current meaning must be indexed through authority/context state.

summary: Corrected the semantic scope of AR-01: it is a minimal joint+parent mechanical-feedback intervention, not a full RigAnything-formulation test.
local_effect: AR-01 remains scientifically valid under its preregistered matched AR0/AR1 design.
global_effect: A future AR-01 result cannot be widened into a verdict on diffusion+skeleton-token+sibling/BFS RigAnything formulation mechanics.
claim_changes: REVOKE: 'AR-01 tests the full RigAnything autoregressive formulation.'
KEEP: 'AR-01 tests whether the preregistered minimal generated/teacher joint+parent mechanical feedback helps this Mage FIT1 configuration.'

summary: Recorded that the fuller RigAnything-mechanism challenger already exists and must be inspected before proposing any new clean-room reimplementation.
local_effect: Prevents repeated discovery/reimplementation of C3/C4 mechanisms.
global_effect: Preserves the scientific reason component mechanisms were split into controlled experiments while keeping the complete formulation lineage available.
claim_changes: KEEP: source existence is not an authoritative full-formulation result.
